capabilities: Track recurring chores as notes with frontmatter intervals and schedules
View chores grouped by due date with a visual urgency bar
Complete, snooze, skip and undo chores from the view
Focus on a small daily subset of chores with a no-pressure mode
Embed a chore's row and history strip in its note via a choreday code block
extras: README has an explicit Limitations section: no reminders outside Obsidian, short history by design, weekly-only calendar chores, and mobile long-press only checked in emulation.
motivation: The README says chores don't fit reminders or to-do lists because what matters is often when a chore was last done, not a fixed deadline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring chores with intervals, due dates and completion history, and regular task tools don't capture the 'how long since last done' pattern of household chores.

relations.evidence: remain readable as Properties, Bases and in Dataview

summary: Chore tracker that stores each recurring household chore as a vault note and shows what is due, upcoming and overdue in a Chores view.
